assessments.title: Hormuz crude-export constraint
assessments.headline: EIA baseline flows establish the scale and destination concentration; current route economics remain unavailable.

hops.label: Hormuz oil-flow baseline
hops.summary: EIA first-half 2025 oil-flow baselines remain historical. Reuters reported at least five shipping incidents in the 48 hours before Oct 14, including a vessel sinking; current comparable Hormuz transit and route-specific flow volumes remain unavailable.

hops.label: Crude export baseline
hops.summary: Reuters reports Kpler total September oil exports of 18.6 million bpd. A separate seven-country crude-and-condensate series was 14.7 million bpd, up from 10.8 in August; these regional export figures do not isolate Hormuz transits.

hops.label: VLCC freight
hops.summary: Same-unit Gulf of Oman-to-China VLCC freight remains carried at $11.50/bbl from Sep 11. Reuters reported new shipping incidents and a vessel sinking near Hormuz on Oct 14, but no newer route-normalised freight quote was verified; daily charter quotes are not converted.

hops.label: Asian destination concentration
hops.summary: GME OQD NOV26 marker remains carried at $111.58/bbl from Sep 25; EIA Asian destination shares are historical context.

hops.label: Named buyer relationship
hops.summary: The approved EIA sources identify destination countries, not company-level buyers.
